shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"'"
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules -maxdepth 3 -type d | rg 'chart|yagr|uikit' | head -40; rg \"theme|useTheme|ThemeProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/index.d.ts -n | head -60"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -80; rg \"export .*useTheme|declare function useTheme|theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' -n | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version dependencies peerDependencies && npm install @gravity-ui/yagr'
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -80; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr -maxdepth 4 -type f -name '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/react.d.ts; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts; rg -n \"setData|destroy|setSeries|resize|update\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | head -40; rg -n \"import|createRoot|useYagr|<Yagr\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/mixins/dynamic-updates.d.ts; rg -n \"interface UpdateOptions\" -A30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; rg -n \"interface YagrConfig|type YagrConfig|settings|adaptive|theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -60"
/bin/bash -lc "cat src/components/monitoring-chart.tsx | head -10; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json | sed -n '20,80p'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s|import type {MinimalValidConfig} from '@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types';|import type {MinimalValidConfig} from '@gravity-ui/yagr';|\" src/components/monitoring-chart.tsx
sed -i \"s|import '@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.min.css';|import '@gravity-ui/yagr/index.css';|\" src/main.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v chromium chromium-browser google-chrome || true; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr main types'
